title: TEST DATA - placeholder values, NOT AS/NZS 3000

_format.tables: One entry per Appendix C table column. inst is single (Table C1 single domestic), multi (Table C1 blocks of living units) or nondom (Table C2, also used for Industrial). For multi, unitsMin/unitsMax pick the column by the number of units on each phase.
_format.groups: code (e.g. A(i)), desc, optional note shown in the working, and a rule.

rule types.points: firstA amps for the first 'first' points, plus stepA amps for each further 'step' points or part. Qty = points. {t:'points', first, firstA, step, stepA}
rule types.largestPlus: largestPct % of the largest single item + restPct % of the rest. largestPct defaults to 100. {t:'largestPlus', largestPct, restPct}
rule types.perUnit: fixedA + perUnitA x number of living units on the phase (n = 1 outside multiple domestic). {t:'perUnit', fixedA, perUnitA}
rule types.fixed: Fixed amps whenever the group has a load. {t:'fixed', A}

_format.reserved: Group code ASSESS is built into the calculator (By assessment, own diversity %).
